run_update_test_checks: run update_test_checks.py to regenerate FileCheck statements for LLVM opt regression tests
run_update_single_function: run update_test_checks.py with --function flag to update FileCheck patterns for a single LLVM function
run_update_verbose: run update_test_checks.py with --verbose flag to see detailed output during FileCheck regeneration
run_update_custom_opt_binary: run update_test_checks.py with --opt-binary flag to specify a custom opt binary path
run_update_multiple_tests: run update_test_checks.py with multiple test file arguments to update FileCheck patterns across several LLVM IR files
